quiet_drift_selection_definition.population: liquid pre-selection universe after quality exclusions
quiet_drift_selection_definition.global_tail: top or bottom configured quantile of sector-relative 63d or 126d return
quiet_drift_selection_definition.sector_coverage: non-overlapping top then bottom per sector after quietness filters and the minimum tail-distance guard
quiet_drift_selection_definition.anchor_rules: 63d uses 63d relative quietness; 126d additionally requires 126d stock and relative quietness plus same-direction 63d/126d sector-relative returns

volume_ratio_definition: mean adjusted volume, latest 5 sessions / preceding 20 sessions
